title: Pulmonary nodules: whole reporting and13-question conditional structure draft
source_contract_definition: Exact current effective reporting/report_templates/walkthrough/reading snapshot at base main; proposals are separate and do not overwrite historical contract.

reporting_checklist.label: Eligibility
reporting_checklist.detail: Check age, immune status, cancer history and screening context.

reporting_checklist.label: Nodule type
reporting_checklist.detail: Distinguish solid, pure ground glass and part-solid.

reporting_checklist.label: Morphology
reporting_checklist.detail: Assess margins, fat, calcium, perifissural shape and cystic change.

reporting_checklist.label: Measurement
reporting_checklist.detail: Document location, mean diameter or consistent volume, and solid component.

reporting_checklist.label: Growth
reporting_checklist.detail: Use comparable reconstructions and identify the most suspicious lesion in multiple nodules.

reporting_template_sections.heading: PATHWAY
reporting_template_sections.body: Context: [incidental / screening / known malignancy / other]. Age/risk: [ ]. Exclusions: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: NODULE INVENTORY
reporting_template_sections.body: ID/lobe/segment: [ ]. Type: [solid / pure ground glass / part-solid]. Series/image: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: SIZE AND MORPHOLOGY
reporting_template_sections.body: Long/short axes: [ ]/[ ] mm; mean: [ ] mm. Solid component: [ ] mm. Margins/fat/calcium: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: INTERVAL CHANGE
reporting_template_sections.body: Prior date: [ ]. Previous size/volume: [ ]. Growth: [none / present / uncertain]. Reconstruction comparability: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: ASSESSMENT
reporting_template_sections.body: Most suspicious nodule: [ ]. Benign-pattern evidence: [ ]. Applicable guideline/version and recommendation rationale: [ ].
